fullPool.method: NPS 1220-ft elevation contour from 2001 Reclamation bathymetry, hosted by Nevada DWR. Approximate full-pool reference, 0.4 ft above operational full pool (1219.6 ft); not an exact 2009-survey contour. Polygon area differs from the card full-pool table; never inflated to match.
fullPool.label: Full-pool reference · NPS 1220-ft contour

latest.method: MNDWI = (green − SWIR1)/(green + SWIR1) > 0.00 (spectral mask only), at 20m; exclude SCL nodata/defective/cloud/cloud-shadow/snow; NPS/NHD union reference +120m clip; remove components smaller than 2 hectares; topology-preserving 25m simplification.

crossCheck.method: same-date published HDB elevation applied to Reclamation area–capacity table
